faq.q: How is a titanium air sparger pipe manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium air sparger pipe is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion; CNC machining; TIG welding (ERTi-2 filler); Hydrostatic testing. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 2 CP-Ti for titanium air sparger pipe?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Laser welding (higher capital cost, limited wall thickness capability).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium air sparger pipe?
faq.a: Titanium Air Sparger Pipe components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium air sparger pipe?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86). BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.
